description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Illumina is hiring a Software Development Test Engineer 1 to help build its software platform and support instrument integration testing. The role involves resolving routine issues and working with software challenges including large data sets, regulated environments, portability, and scalability.
Software Development Test Engineer 1 supporting platform development and resolving routine instrument-integration and portability issues

Responsibilities:
• Applies basic problem-solving techniques to define and resolve routine issues
• Determines a course of action based on guidelines
• Works on assignments of limited scope where answers can be readily obtained and problem solving requires following standard practices/procedures
• Requires guided leadership and receives general instruction on work/new assignments
• You will help build the team’s expanding software platform, which is the base for our applications
• You will consistently encounter and tackle interesting problems:
• Instrument Integration
• Large data sets
• Regulated environments
• Portability
• Scalability

Requirements:
• Typically requires 0 to 2 years of previous professional experience
• Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Groovy or Python
• Proficiency in linux shell scripting
• Hands on proficiency in using the AI tools like Cursor/Claude-code/VS Code or equivalent AI tools which gain productivity and increase throughput
• Knowledge of popular test automation frameworks particularly Playwright is a must have and Rest API automation
• Understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Familiarity with API testing and understanding of RESTful APIs
• Experience with version control systems like Git for managing test scripts and collaborating with other team members
• Knowledge of Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and experience with Jenkins
• Ability to design effective and efficient test cases covering different scenarios and edge cases, as well as understanding of test data management
• Familiarity with Test Management tools such as Jama/HPALM with a level of managing/creating Requirements/Specification/Test Cases/RTM and Test summary reports in the tool for tracking User Needs to Report artifacts
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify issues, troubleshoot failures, and debug automation scripts
• Understanding of Agile software development methodologies and experience working in Agile teams
• Effective communication skills to collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders
• This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship
